recommendation_ar:
معاك حق: سائل القهوة الحالي ثخين ويبين بلاستيك (شفناه بالتكبير 100٪)، والبرجر والكنافة ما يشهون. اقتراحنا، وكله بدون أي كريدت:
- البداية والقهوة: صبّة حليب على قهوة من إعلان «حبّة» (علامتنا الخيالية). سائلها خفيف وطبيعي، وأحسن من مور ودوز. بعدها حبة بن تطيح، وقلب اللاتيه داخل العدسة.
- البرجر: برجر ستاك والغطا ينزل عليه. أشهى بواجد، والخلفية تصير حمرا.
- العطر: ليل وهو يرش، وبعدين القارورة تبقى، مثل ما قلت. بس للأمانة: هذا شغل ثلاثي الأبعاد مو تصوير، والرشّة تبين نقاط ذهبية، واللقطة داكنة. مسحنا اسم «ليل» عن القارورة.
- الحلو: كيكة دوز اللي ينصب عليها الصوص، بدون شعار ولا اسم. بس هذي كيكتهم المعروفة، مسويينها من صورهم، وهم ما شافوا الإعلان. تبينا نحطها؟ إذا لا، نخلي الكنافة.
- مور: ما نستخدم منه شي، لأن اتفقنا ما ننشر شي منه بدون موافقتهم الكتابية. ومور ودوز كانت عروض تجريبية مو شغل لعملاء، فما نقول عنهم عملاءنا.
البداية الجديدة ما فيها ارتطام ثلج، والضربة تجي من الصوت. لو تبي ثلج يطيح، نسوي لقطة وحدة بستايل «حبّة» بحوالي 7.25 كريدت، بس مو ضروري الحين.
الأرضيات بتصير طبيعية بدال البرتقالي والوردي والأزرق، والليموني يبقى بالعدسات والنهاية.

- Full f0-14 = n40-n54, no shift. Cover frame f10 = n50.

worlds.why: It answers the owner's note directly. At 100% there is crema with bubbles and specks, a thin real milk stream, and latte art forming in natural sun on handmade ceramic. There is no splash or crown at all. On a phone it reads like a café top shot, and it is the most real coffee TASH owns: better than MOR m2 and DOSE d2d, and with no client issue (HABBA is TASH's fictional brand). It also matches the owner's own taste («القهوة تصب احلى»). There is no steam (rule «Espresso never steams»), and the pour comes from the spout. The walnut top makes the Paper word and the lime tag read better than on tangerine.
worlds.risks:
- It has no physical impact, so it fails the spec gates 'impact inside 0.30 s' and 'splash crown by f14'. The hook rests on motion from f0 (the heart drawing itself) plus the 808 and a pour sound.
- §6 acceptance 'names a cold drink' becomes 'names coffee': it is a hot latte.
- The paid S1-alt (12 draft + 64 final) is dropped; keep it as the fallback.
- Y' measures 0.355-0.394 with the mock type, under the 0.40 gate: lift about +0.04 in the grade.
- The «حلو…» tag's lower edge sits on the saucer rim (y about 798-847). The cup and the heart stay clear, so the rim is accepted (or scale 0.95 with a walnut side fill).
- The wind-up ground becomes walnut, not tangerine.
- Still AI (Kling 3.0 Turbo). At 100% the milk inside the pitcher is a little smooth and paint-like, and after n104 the heart outline 'breathes'.
- Rotation inverts the heart (point up). That is natural from the barista's side, but the owner should glance at it.

- Oud A = film f195-209 (S4, the cap sprays), drawn +400 px. The top 400 rows are row 0 replicated, a smooth near-black.
- Oud B = film f210-224 on the same +400 frame, punched in 1.25x about (540,900): the cloud blooms.
- Oud C lens = film f315-329 (S6 hero bottle, clean in the film up to f334). Scale 0.80, source point (540,1175), push 1.00 to 1.04.
- Right porthole f105-134 = film f315-344 at 0.31 about (540,1175).
- Band = film f315-344 drawn +280. The end card that starts at f335 sits at y 400-560, outside the band window; checked on f340.
- Every S6 frame gets a code paint-out of the plinth label «ليل / LAYL / EAU DE PARFUM · No.07» (x about 478-590, y about 1410-1490) and of its floor reflection (y about 1494-1570), by a row-wise lerp. Checked at 2x: a faint hairline is left, invisible at 0.8. A cleaner option is a re-render from src with the label texture off, at 0 credits.

worlds.why: The owner asked for exactly this: LAYL spraying, then the mist goes and LAYL stays, compressed into spray, then bloom, then the bottle held in the lens. It adds the action the current static S2 lacks, and it looks premium. There is no hand, face or text once the label is painted out. Picture is code, not AI. Perfume advertising tolerates CGI far better than food does.
worlds.risks:
- Honest view: this is a Three.js render, not footage. The brass is smooth and slightly plasticky. At 100% (sheet row 3) the spray is crisp, same-size dots and reads as gold glitter, not mist. The juice glows like a lightbox. It fixes 'no action, not premium', not 'looks fake'.
- The full frames are near-black: Y' 0.14-0.16 even with the type. That breaks the 'no frame under Y' 0.40' and 'no Ink field' gates for 30 frames (f165-194). It has to be accepted as a deliberate night beat («ليل» = night).
- The Ink keyline disappears on black. The word and tag still read, better in fact.
- In A and B the bottle is not in frame; the tag «عطر؟» names it. The cap is cut by the right edge, and bevel glints show at the bottom left.
- The hot-pink world is gone.

Entering at f210 and leaving at f240 is one pair in a second, inside WCAG's limit but against the spec as written: run PEAT and amend the rule. opener:
Replace it. The owner's note («السائل كأنه ثخين ولعبة») is aimed at this exact shot. At 100% the S1-alt crown is opaque, creamy sheets, and no remap fixes that: the ice touching the coffee and the crown are the same moment. The new opener is HABBA k3_pour rotated 180° (barista view): full f0-14 = n40-n54, punch f15-29 = n55-n69 at 1.25x about (540,640), cover f10 = n50, loop = frozen n40.

Why: it is the most real coffee TASH owns. The milk stream is thin and real, the crema and latte art form in natural sun, and there is no splash at all. HABBA is our own fictional brand. The owner likes pours («القهوة تصب احلى»). The calm walnut top gives the strongest type contrast of any candidate.

What we give up:
- No physical impact in 0.3 s. That is a spec gate we waive; the hit comes from the 808 plus a pour sound.
- No 'cold drink'.
- The 76 credits paid for S1-alt (12 + 64). Keep S1-alt as the fallback.

Rejected openers:
- k4 beans: a real impact, but a soft little tap on brown blobs that won't stop a scroll. It is used as Coffee A instead.
- STAKK b7 crown landing: the strongest impact, but the bun has to enter from the top edge, and the landed crown sits under the tag (y 610-880 against y 552-847). No shift fixes both.
- DOSE d2d: dose's print is on the cup in every frame.
- MOR m2/m3: no impact, and MOR is off-limits.
- LAYL S4: CGI, not 'real'.

If the owner wants ice crashing back: one new still plus one Kling 3.0 Pro clip in the HABBA look (clear ice into thin black iced coffee, walnut, sun bars), about 7.25 credits, priced to him first. Not recommended now.
honesty:
MOR (@morkwt) and specialty dose (@sdosecafe) are real cafés in Al Jahra. Both films were unsolicited spec pitches, not paid client work, and all their footage is AI (Kling/Seedance) generated from those cafés' own photos. So they are not 'works we made for companies', and nothing in the ad, caption or replies may call or imply them clients.

MOR: none used.
- HANDOFF §3, owner rule: never post MOR material on TASH without MOR's written approval. A TASH paid boost is a TASH post.
- m1, m3, m4, m5, m6 and m7 all carry MOR marks: sign, wordmark, keyhole emblem, printed cup, wax paper, tray emboss.
- Even the mark-free crops (the m2 pour lens, the m3 rim crop, the m6 pecan lens) show MOR's recognisable brass bar, burgundy cup and logo paper.
- HABBA k3 beats m2 on realism and on fit anyway.

DOSE: only d4_cake n0-n31 is mark-free.
- d2d and d3 carry the AI «specialty dose cafe» print on every frame. d5b has the sign and the facade on every frame. d1 shows fake text plates from n48. d3's stream is also thick.
- d4 can run without implying a client only if: no name, tag or mention anywhere; the AI label stays on; it is never described as client work.
- The owner must confirm in writing that he accepts the residual risk: it is dose's signature cake, a regular may recognise it, and dose has not seen or approved the spec. If he says no, keep the kunafa.

Fictional brands:
- HABBA, STAKK and LAYL are TASH's own fictional brands, so reusing them implies no client.
- The chosen shots carry no logo, sign, label, readable text, face or hand.
- The only mark is LAYL S6's plinth label «ليل LAYL» and its reflection. It is painted out in code (checked at 2x), so INVENTORY §D's concept label is not needed for these shots.

Labels and status:
- The AI label stays ON: k3, k4, b7 and d4 are AI. LAYL is code-rendered.
- Status per HANDOFF: HABBA, STAKK and LAYL are delivered in TASH-Kit, but owner approval and whether he posted them himself are not recorded and need confirmation. MOR and DOSE are delivered, not approved, not published.
- I edited no repo file, so HANDOFF.md was not updated; the parent should log this step.
